headline: OECD projects Colombia GDP growth to slow to 2.1% in 2027 amid fiscal pressures
summary: The OECD forecasts Colombia's economic growth will slow to 2.1% in 2027, down from 2.6% in preceding years, as tight financial conditions and a fiscal deficit exceeding 7% of GDP restrain activity.
why: Colombia is an emerging South American market economy. OECD growth forecasts inform government budget targets and sovereign credit assessment.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Growth is expected to decelerate to 2.1% as fiscal deficits remain elevated.
